refnamediv.refpurpose: Receives data from a socket, connected or not

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
The socket to read from: a bound UDP socket, an accepted connection or one end of a socket pair, for example.
length
The maximum number of bytes to receive from the socket. Fewer bytes are returned if less data is pending.
flags
The value of flags can be any combination of the following:
Possible values for flags
STREAM_OOB
Process OOB (out-of-band) data.
STREAM_PEEK
Retrieve data from the socket, but do not consume it. Subsequent calls to stream_socket_recvfrom will see the same data.
address
If address is provided it will be populated with the address of the remote socket. It is an empty string for a socket that has no peer address, such as an accepted TCP connection or a Unix stream socket pair, and at end of file. It is reset to &null; at the start of every call, even if the call returns &false; or throws.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the read data, as a string. An empty string is returned at the end of a stream socket, on each call. &false; is returned, without any warning, if no data is pending on a non-blocking socket, if no urgent data is available with STREAM_OOB, and if socket is not a socket stream (such as php://memory or a plain file).

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if length is less than 1.
